question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is '**launched**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate answer for the second blank is 'launched'. • The most appropriate title for the given blank is 'History of India's Space Journey'. • The past is used to describe things that have already happened (e.g., earlier in the day, yesterday, last week, three years ago). • *Example: I **worked** very hard while I was in this company.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **​Correct Passage:__** *In its 47 years of history, ISRO has done breakthrough work in the field of technology and even **launched** many vehicles into space. (3) ______ the last 47 years, ISRO has improvised and developed technology, launching (4) ______ indigenously created vehicles into space (5) ______ form a part of the Indian space journey.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **block**: to make it difficult or impossible for somebody/something to pass. (अवरोध या बाधा द्वारा आवागमन में रोक डालना) • **stock**: the supply of things that a shop, etc. has for sale. [(दुकान आदि में रखा) बिक्री के लिए माल; स्‍टॉक] • **share**: to divide something between two or more people. (किसी वस्‍तु को दो या अधिक लोगों में बाँटना) 47:T7fe, The correct answer is '**Over**'.
